name: codeguard
description: Cross-language code lint enforcement for AI coding assistants (ZCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi Code): Java, Rust, TypeScript, Python. PostToolUse hook auto-runs the native linter on every AI-written file and blocks on failure in strict mode.

interface.shortDescription: Make AI-written code pass lint on first try
interface.longDescription: Detects project languages, runs the appropriate linter (mvn javadoc+checkstyle, cargo clippy+fmt, npx eslint, ruff check) on every file the AI writes or edits, and blocks further writes when lints fail. Ships ready-to-use .pre-commit-config.yaml templates and AGENTS.md snippets for one-line project bootstrap. Supports ZCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Kimi Code through their respective plugin manifests.
defaultPrompt: Run /check on the current project and fix what fails
Initialize codeguard on this repository with /init
Run Java javadoc + checkstyle on the current project
